name: NestNyx
description: Shared-folder-scoped rclone execution API and OAuth-protected MCP server for Nyx

NYX_API_KEY.description: Secret key required in the X-Nyx-Key header for the REST API.

NYX_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public HTTPS origin of this Heroku app, for example https://your-app.herokuapp.com.

NYX_OAUTH_ISSUER.description: OAuth/OIDC issuer URL used by ChatGPT to authorize access to the MCP server.

NYX_OAUTH_AUDIENCE.description: Audience/resource identifier that NestNyx requires in MCP access tokens.

NYX_OAUTH_JWKS_URI.description: Optional JWKS endpoint override. Leave unset for issuer/.well-known/jwks.json.

NYX_OAUTH_SCOPES.description: Comma-separated MCP scopes. Defaults to nyx.read,nyx.write.

RCLONE_CONFIG_B64.description: Base64-encoded rclone.conf. Keep this only in Heroku config vars.

NYX_SHARED_ROOTS_JSON.description: JSON map of logical area names to rclone remote/root and optional expectedOwner.
